say:2:1610727002:1.text: I've been waiting for you. I know this is a sensitive time, but I have a bold request...
say:2:1610727002:1.source_cn: 伊芙特使，我是在这里等你的。我知道现在是特殊时期，但我...

say:3:1610727003:1.text: I'd like to help investigate Headmaster Leymar's death. Anything at all, even the smallest task—I just want to help.
say:3:1610727003:1.source_cn: 我……我希望能协助你调查雷蒙校长死亡一事……无论做什么...

say:4:1610727004:1.text: You want to assist me? Why?
say:4:1610727004:1.source_cn: 协助我调查？我想知道你的理由。

say:5:1610727005:1.text: I'm from the Grenvalden family. When Headmaster Leymar was young, he fought alongside my grandfather. They were close.
say:5:1610727005:1.source_cn: 伊芙特使，我来自格伦沃顿家族。雷蒙校长年轻的时候曾与我...

say:6:1610727006:1.text: My grades were mediocre when I took the entrance exam. The headmaster personally overrode objections and admitted me into the preparatory class, letting me study here and become who I am today.
say:6:1610727006:1.source_cn: 我入学考试时成绩平平，是雷蒙校长力排众议，将我录取进预...

say:7:1610727007:1.text: Since then, within the rules, he's often looked out for me, even tutoring me in subjects I struggled with.
say:7:1610727007:1.source_cn: 自我入校以来，校长在规则范围内给予了我不少关照，甚至会...

say:8:1610727008:1.text: He once told me he hoped I'd get the best magical education and become an outstanding mage, fulfilling my grandfather's wish: to restore the honor of the Grenvalden family.
say:8:1610727008:1.source_cn: 他曾对我说，他希望我能接受最好的魔法教育，成为出色的魔...

say:9:1610727009:1.text: So now... I feel I have to do something for him. If I just stand by and do nothing, I'll feel miserable and guilty.
say:9:1610727009:1.source_cn: 所以现在……我想我得为雷蒙校长做些什么。就这样站在一边...

say:10:1610727010:1.text: I know the rules say I shouldn't involve you in this, but I understand how you feel.
say:10:1610727010:1.source_cn: 按照规定，我不应该让你参与这件事，但我很理解你的想法。

say:11:1610727011:1.text: And as you've probably guessed, I'm not one to blindly follow protocol. I've already asked <style="stress"><player_name></style> to assist me.
say:11:1610727011:1.source_cn: 我想你也发现了，我并不是只会刻板遵守规则的人。我已经请...
say:11:1610727011:1.male: And as you've probably guessed, I'm not one to blindly follow protocol. I've already asked <style="stress"><player_name></style> to assist me.
say:11:1610727011:1.female: And as you've probably guessed, I'm not one to blindly follow protocol. I've already asked <style="stress"><player_name></style> to assist me.

say:12:1610727012:1.text: That's why I felt I could make this request.
say:12:1610727012:1.source_cn: 正是因为看到这一点，我才冒昧提出这个请求的。

say:13:1610727013:1.text: You recall how Silven was evasive during his interrogation, and how you and Evie have always found him a little suspicious.
say:13:1610727013:1.source_cn: 休在审讯中有所隐瞒，你和伊芙对他一直有些怀疑。
say:13:1610727013:1.male: You recall how Silven was evasive during his interrogation, and how you and Evie have always found him a little suspicious.
say:13:1610727013:1.female: You recall how Silven was evasive during his interrogation, and how you and Evie have always found him a little suspicious.

say:16:1610727015:1.text: ... Very well. You may accompany us into the headmaster's office to collect clues. However, you will be under constant supervision.
say:16:1610727015:1.source_cn: ……既然如此，那么我允许你进入校长办公室，同我一起收集线索。

say:17:1610727016:1.text: Do not touch anything without permission, stay close to us at all times, and report anything you find to me immediately.
say:17:1610727016:1.source_cn: 但你必须全程接受管控，不得随意触碰办公室内的任何物品，...

say:19:1610727018:1.text: I do! Thank you for your trust, Envoy.
say:19:1610727018:1.source_cn: 我接受！非常感谢你的信任，伊芙特使。
